items.zh: 随着城市人口不断增加，住房、交通和教育都面临新的压力。
items.reference: As the urban population keeps growing, housing, transport and education all face new pressure.
variants: With the continued growth of city populations, housing, transport and education are under new pressure.
items.skeleton: As A grows, B, C and D + face + pressure
info_points: 住房交通教育面临压力

items.zh: 中国地域辽阔，不同地区的气候、饮食和生活方式差异很大。
items.reference: China is a vast country, and climate, food and ways of life vary greatly from region to region.
variants: As a vast country, China shows great differences in climate, food and lifestyle across regions.
items.skeleton: China + is + vast; climate, food and ways + vary
info_points: 气候饮食生活方式差异大

items.zh: 这项政策实施后，农村学生的辍学率明显下降。
items.reference: After the policy was introduced, the dropout rate among rural students fell noticeably.
variants: The introduction of the policy led to a clear drop in the rural student dropout rate.
items.skeleton: After the policy + was introduced, the rate + fell

items.zh: 博物馆免费开放，使更多普通家庭有机会接触历史文物。
items.reference: Free admission to museums gives more ordinary families access to historical relics.
variants: Because museums are free, more ordinary families can see historical relics.
items.skeleton: Free admission + gives + families access to relics

items.zh: 研究表明，睡眠不足会影响记忆，也会降低学习和工作的效率。
items.reference: Research shows that lack of sleep affects memory and reduces efficiency in study and work.
variants: Studies indicate that insufficient sleep harms memory and lowers efficiency in learning and work.
items.skeleton: Research + shows that A + affects B and reduces C

items.zh: 这座桥建成以后，两岸居民的往来时间从两个小时缩短到二十分钟。
items.reference: After the bridge was completed, travel time between the two banks fell from two hours to twenty minutes.
variants: The bridge cut residents' travel time between the two banks from two hours to twenty minutes.
items.skeleton: After the bridge + was completed, travel time + fell from A to B
info_points: 往来时间从两小时缩短到二十分钟

items.zh: 越来越多的年轻人选择在节假日到乡村旅行，体验与城市不同的生活节奏。
items.reference: More and more young people choose to travel to the countryside during holidays and experience a pace of life different from that of the city.
variants: An increasing number of young people spend holidays in the countryside to experience a slower pace of life.
items.skeleton: young people + choose + to travel and experience

items.zh: 学校应当为有困难的学生提供心理辅导和经济支持。
items.reference: Schools should provide psychological counselling and financial support for students in need.
variants: Students facing difficulties should receive both counselling and financial help from their schools.
items.skeleton: schools + should provide + A and B for C

items.zh: 长期使用电子设备可能损害视力，尤其是在光线不足的环境中。
items.reference: Long-term use of electronic devices may damage eyesight, especially in poor light.
variants: Using electronic devices for long periods can harm eyesight, particularly when the light is dim.
items.skeleton: long-term use + may damage + eyesight
info_points: 长期用电子设备损害视力

items.zh: 许多传统手工艺因为缺少年轻学徒而面临失传的危险。
items.reference: Many traditional crafts face the danger of dying out because they lack young apprentices.
variants: A lack of young apprentices puts many traditional crafts at risk of disappearing.
items.skeleton: crafts + face + the danger + because they lack apprentices

items.zh: 政府在改善农村医疗条件方面投入了大量资金。
items.reference: The government has invested heavily in improving medical conditions in rural areas.
variants: A large amount of government funding has gone into rural healthcare.
items.skeleton: the government + has invested + in improving conditions

items.zh: 阅读经典作品可以帮助我们理解不同时代的人如何思考和生活。
items.reference: Reading classic works helps us understand how people in different periods thought and lived.
variants: Classic literature offers insight into how people of other eras thought and lived.
items.skeleton: reading classics + helps + us understand

items.zh: 直到最近几年，人们才开始重视心理健康问题。
items.reference: Only in recent years have people begun to pay attention to mental health.
variants: People did not pay much attention to mental health until recent years.
items.skeleton: Only in recent years + have people + begun to ...

items.zh: 他不仅完成了自己的任务，还主动帮助了其他同学。
items.reference: He not only completed his own task but also offered to help other students.
variants: Besides finishing his own work, he took the initiative to help his classmates.
items.skeleton: He + not only completed + but also offered

items.zh: 正是这次失败让他意识到准备的重要性。
items.reference: It was this failure that made him realise the importance of preparation.
variants: This failure was what made him aware of how important preparation is.
items.skeleton: It was + this failure + that made him realise

items.zh: 为了方便居民，社区在周末也开放了服务中心。
items.reference: To make things easier for residents, the community keeps its service centre open at weekends.
variants: The community service centre also opens at weekends for the convenience of residents.
items.skeleton: To + make things easier, the community + keeps + the centre open

items.zh: 只有在实践中不断尝试，才能真正掌握一门技能。
items.reference: Only by constantly trying in practice can one truly master a skill.
variants: A skill can be truly mastered only through repeated practice.
items.skeleton: Only by + trying + can one + master + a skill

items.zh: 随着网络的普及，人们获取信息的方式发生了很大变化。
items.reference: With the spread of the internet, the way people obtain information has changed greatly.
variants: The spread of the internet has greatly changed how people get information.
keywords: with the spread of the internet
items.skeleton: With + the spread, the way + has changed

items.zh: 虽然这项工程耗资巨大，但它改善了数百万人的出行条件，因此得到了广泛支持。
items.reference: Although the project cost a great deal, it improved travel conditions for millions of people and therefore won wide support.
variants: The project was expensive, but it won wide support because it improved travel for millions.
items.skeleton: Although A, it + improved + B and won + support

items.zh: 那些从小接触音乐的孩子，往往在语言学习和团队合作中表现得更自信。
items.reference: Children who are exposed to music from an early age often show greater confidence in language learning and teamwork.
variants: Early exposure to music often makes children more confident in learning languages and working in teams.
items.skeleton: Children who + are exposed to music + often show + confidence
info_points: 语言学习与团队合作更自信

items.zh: 城市里的老建筑不仅记录了历史，也为今天的社区提供了独特的公共空间。
items.reference: Old buildings in cities not only record history but also provide distinctive public spaces for today's communities.
variants: Besides preserving history, old urban buildings offer communities unusual public space.
items.skeleton: Old buildings + not only record + but also provide + spaces

items.zh: 如果学校只重视考试分数，学生就可能缺少独立思考和解决实际问题的机会。
items.reference: If schools focus only on test scores, students may lack opportunities to think independently and solve practical problems.
variants: A narrow focus on exam results may leave students with few chances to think for themselves and solve real problems.
items.skeleton: If schools + focus on + scores, students + may lack + opportunities
info_points: 缺少独立思考和解决问题机会

items.zh: 这家企业通过改进技术降低了成本，同时减少了对环境的污染。
items.reference: By improving its technology, the company reduced costs while cutting environmental pollution.
variants: Technological improvements allowed the company to lower costs and reduce pollution at the same time.
items.skeleton: By + improving technology, the company + reduced + costs

items.zh: 许多游客选择淡季出行，因为此时景点人少，价格也更便宜。
items.reference: Many tourists choose to travel in the off-season, when attractions are less crowded and prices are lower.
variants: Off-season travel appeals to many tourists because attractions are quieter and cheaper.
items.skeleton: tourists + choose + to travel in the off-season

items.zh: 成功的关键在于坚持，而不是天赋。
items.reference: The key to success lies in persistence rather than talent.
variants: Perseverance, not natural talent, is what matters most for success.
items.skeleton: The key + lies in + persistence

items.zh: 他的演讲给听众留下了深刻的印象。
items.reference: His speech left a deep impression on the audience.
variants: The audience was deeply impressed by his speech.
items.skeleton: His speech + left + an impression on the audience

items.zh: 这项发明对医学的发展产生了重要影响。
items.reference: This invention had a significant influence on the development of medicine.
variants: The development of medicine was significantly influenced by this invention.
items.skeleton: This invention + had + an influence on development
info_points: 对医学发展有重要影响

items.zh: 我们应该更加重视传统文化的保护。
items.reference: We should pay more attention to the protection of traditional culture.
variants: Greater importance should be attached to preserving traditional culture.
items.skeleton: We + should pay + attention to protection

items.zh: 他能够用简单的方式解释复杂的概念。
items.reference: He is able to explain complex concepts in a simple way.
variants: He can make complex ideas easy to understand.
items.skeleton: He + is able to explain + concepts

items.zh: 这本书之所以受欢迎，是因为它把理论讲得生动有趣。
items.reference: The book is popular because it presents theory in a lively and interesting way.
variants: Readers like the book for its lively presentation of theory.
items.skeleton: The book + is popular + because it presents theory

items.zh: 春节期间，家家户户都会准备丰盛的饭菜。
items.reference: During the Spring Festival, every household prepares a rich meal.
variants: At Spring Festival time, families everywhere cook generous meals.
items.skeleton: every household + prepares + a rich meal

items.zh: 他每天早上六点起床，然后跑步半小时。
items.reference: He gets up at six every morning and then runs for half an hour.
variants: Every morning he rises at six and goes for a thirty-minute run.
items.skeleton: He + gets up + and runs

items.zh: 这个问题很复杂，需要从多个角度来分析。
items.reference: This problem is complex and needs to be analysed from several perspectives.
variants: Several perspectives are needed to analyse this complicated issue.
items.skeleton: This problem + needs to be analysed + from perspectives

items.zh: 随着人口老龄化，社会对护理人员的需求不断增加。
items.reference: As the population ages, society's demand for care workers keeps rising.
variants: An ageing population has steadily increased the need for care workers.
items.skeleton: As + the population ages, demand + keeps rising

items.zh: 这家博物馆收藏了大量珍贵的文物。
items.reference: The museum houses a large collection of valuable cultural relics.
variants: A great number of valuable relics are kept in this museum.
items.skeleton: The museum + houses + a collection

items.zh: 为了保护环境，许多城市开始限制一次性塑料制品的使用。
items.reference: To protect the environment, many cities have begun to restrict the use of disposable plastics.
variants: Many cities now limit single-use plastics in order to protect the environment.
items.skeleton: To + protect + the environment, cities + restrict + the use

items.zh: 中秋节是家人团聚、赏月的日子。
items.reference: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a time for family reunion and moon watching.
variants: Families come together and admire the moon during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
items.skeleton: The festival + is + a time for A and B

items.zh: 中医强调通过调节身体来预防疾病。
items.reference: Traditional Chinese Medicine emphasises preventing illness by regulating the body.
variants: Chinese medicine stresses keeping the body in balance to prevent disease.
items.skeleton: TCM + emphasises + preventing illness

items.zh: 四合院是北京传统民居的典型形式。
items.reference: The courtyard house is a typical form of traditional housing in Beijing.
variants: Beijing's traditional homes are typically built as courtyard houses.
items.skeleton: The courtyard house + is + a typical form

items.zh: 二十四节气反映了中国古代对自然规律的认识。
items.reference: The twenty-four solar terms reflect ancient China's understanding of natural patterns.
variants: Ancient Chinese knowledge of nature is embodied in the twenty-four solar terms.
items.skeleton: The solar terms + reflect + understanding
info_points: 反映对自然规律的认识

items.zh: 太极拳动作缓慢，强调呼吸与身体的协调。
items.reference: Tai Chi moves slowly and emphasises coordination between breathing and the body.
variants: Tai Chi is slow and focuses on coordinating breath and movement.
items.skeleton: Tai Chi + moves slowly and emphasises + coordination

items.zh: 元宵节人们吃汤圆、看花灯，象征团圆和幸福。
items.reference: During the Lantern Festival, people eat sweet rice balls and watch lanterns, which symbolise reunion and happiness.
variants: Sweet rice balls and lanterns at the Lantern Festival stand for family reunion and joy.
items.skeleton: people + eat + and watch + lanterns

items.zh: 中国的人口数量居世界前列，但近年来增长明显放缓。
items.reference: China has one of the largest populations in the world, but its growth has slowed noticeably in recent years.
variants: While China remains among the most populous countries, population growth has clearly slowed.
items.skeleton: China + has + one of the largest populations

items.zh: 这条高铁线路全长约一千公里，把两地之间的旅行时间缩短了一半。
items.reference: The high-speed line is about one thousand kilometres long and has cut travel time between the two cities by half.
variants: The roughly 1,000-kilometre high-speed line has halved the journey time between the two cities.
items.skeleton: The line + is + about 1000 km long and has cut + time

items.zh: 与十年前相比，网上购物的人数增加了三倍多。
items.reference: Compared with ten years ago, the number of online shoppers has more than tripled.
variants: The number of people shopping online is more than three times what it was a decade ago.
items.skeleton: Compared with + ten years ago, the number + has tripled

items.zh: 这项调查覆盖了全国二十个城市的三千名受访者。
items.reference: The survey covered three thousand respondents in twenty cities across the country.
variants: Three thousand people from twenty cities nationwide took part in the survey.
items.skeleton: The survey + covered + respondents in cities

items.zh: 会议持续了三个小时，比原计划多出一个小时。
items.reference: The meeting lasted three hours, one hour longer than planned.
variants: The meeting ran for three hours instead of the planned two.
items.skeleton: The meeting + lasted + three hours

items.zh: 研究表明，每天步行三十分钟可以显著降低患病风险。
items.reference: Research shows that walking for thirty minutes a day can significantly reduce the risk of illness.
variants: A daily thirty-minute walk may greatly lower the chance of disease.
items.skeleton: Research + shows that walking + can reduce + risk

items.zh: 近年来，越来越多的家庭开始重视孩子的早期教育。
items.reference: In recent years, more and more families have begun to value early childhood education.
variants: Early childhood education has gained growing attention from families in recent years.
items.skeleton: families + have begun to value + education

items.zh: 据报道，今年夏天的平均气温创下了历史新高。
items.reference: It is reported that this summer's average temperature reached a record high.
variants: Reports say that average temperatures this summer hit an all-time high.
items.skeleton: It is reported that + temperature + reached + a record high

items.zh: 有必要为老年人提供更多的公共活动空间。
items.reference: It is necessary to provide more public space for older people.
variants: More public space should be made available for the elderly.
items.skeleton: It is necessary + to provide + space
info_points: 为老年人提供公共空间

items.zh: 可以通过减少一次性用品来降低垃圾数量。
items.reference: The amount of waste can be reduced by using fewer disposable products.
variants: Using less disposable packaging helps cut the volume of rubbish.
items.skeleton: The amount of waste + can be reduced + by using fewer products

items.zh: 希望学校能够为学生提供更多实践机会。
items.reference: It is hoped that schools will offer students more opportunities for practice.
variants: Schools are expected to give students more hands-on experience.
items.skeleton: It is hoped that + schools + will offer + opportunities

items.zh: 应该鼓励年轻人参与社区服务。
items.reference: Young people should be encouraged to take part in community service.
variants: Community service is something young people should be urged to join.
items.skeleton: Young people + should be encouraged + to take part

items.zh: 这项政策旨在帮助低收入家庭，但它也需要更多的资金支持。
items.reference: The policy aims to help low-income families, but it also needs more funding.
variants: Although the policy targets low-income families, it still requires additional funding.
items.skeleton: The policy + aims to help + families, but it + needs + funding

items.zh: 许多学生喜欢在线课程，因为它可以让他们自由安排时间。
items.reference: Many students like online courses because they allow them to arrange their time freely.
variants: Online courses appeal to many students since they offer flexible schedules.
items.skeleton: students + like + courses because they + allow + them

items.zh: 父母应该倾听孩子的想法，而不是替他们做所有决定。
items.reference: Parents should listen to their children's ideas instead of making every decision for them.
variants: Rather than deciding everything for their children, parents should hear what the children think.
items.skeleton: Parents + should listen + instead of making decisions

items.zh: 这家公司重视员工的意见，因此员工也愿意为公司付出更多努力。
items.reference: The company values its employees' opinions, so they are willing to make more effort for it.
variants: Because employees' views are valued, they are ready to work harder for the company.
items.skeleton: The company + values + opinions, so they + are willing

items.zh: 传统文化需要保护，但保护并不意味着把它固定在博物馆里。
items.reference: Traditional culture needs protection, but protection does not mean fixing it in a museum.
variants: Protecting traditional culture is necessary, yet it should not be locked away in museums.
items.skeleton: culture + needs + protection, but protection + does not mean + fixing
info_points: 保护不等于放进博物馆

items.zh: 阅读能拓宽视野，因此我们应该让它在日常生活中占有一席之地。
items.reference: Reading broadens our horizons, so we should give it a place in our daily lives.
variants: Since reading widens our horizons, it deserves a regular place in daily life.
items.skeleton: Reading + broadens + horizons, so we + should give + it a place
info_points: 应在日常生活中占位置
